samples.name: icon-task-chop-wood
samples.prompt: One tiny inventory/task icon for cozy medieval Slavic village game, style matching supplied Kenney Tiny Town and Tiny Farm. Strict 16x16 logical pixel art enlarged with nearest-neighbor; very chunky simple squares, flat colors maximum two shades per material, earthy palette. Entire subject centered with one logical pixel transparent margin. Transparent background. No gradients, texture, antialiasing, shadows, lettering, border, scenery or extra subjects. Woodcutter's iron axe stuck in a short brown log, two small wood chips flying. Broad grey axe head and short tan cut face on log, instantly readable.
